mapper.sql: SELECT tk.id, tk.task_no, tk.request_id, tk.tree_id, t.tree_code, t.species, t.area, t.location, tk.worker_id, w.real_name AS worker_name, tk.client_id, c.client_name, tk.trim_type, tk.plan_time, tk.finish_time, tk.status, tk.priority, tk.description, tk.create_time FROM trim_task tk LEFT JOIN tree t ON tk.tree_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_user w ON tk.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_client c ON tk.client_id = c.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, request_id, tree_id, worker_id, client_id, trim_type, plan_time, finish_time, status, priority, description, create_time, update_time FROM trim_task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trim_task (task_no, request_id, tree_id, worker_id, client_id, trim_type, plan_time, status, priority, description, create_time) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{requestId}, #{treeId}, #{workerId}, #{clientId}, #{trimType}, #{planTime}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{description}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE trim_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE trim_task SET worker_id = #{workerId}, status = 'PENDING', update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE trim_task SET status = 'DONE', finish_time = ISNULL(finish_time, SYSDATETIME()), update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trim_task WHERE task_no LIKE #{prefix} + '%'
